title: ContactStore::advance_state exposed as pub but bypasses per-row counter stamp
description: ContactStore::advance_state() is public and calls the private advance_state() fn which only bumps state_counters — it does NOT stamp any contact row's changed_at_counter. Any caller that uses advance_state() directly will advance the global counter without marking any row as changed. A subsequent ChatContact/changes call would see new_state > since_state, run the SQL query, find no rows with changed_at_counter > since_counter, and return empty added/updated lists — a phantom state advance that confuses clients. ChatStore::advance_state() has the same problem. Both should either be removed or should require a peer_user_id / chat_id argument. Currently only ContactChangesHandler (JMAP) calls advance_state — checking what it does with it is needed before closing this.
